nodes.label: Surplus AI
nodes.summary: Private, offline AI system for ASU Surplus, in production. Built on the job from June 2026; processing per item dropped from about 15 min to about 3 min.

content.title: Surplus AI
content.oneLiner: Private, offline AI system for ASU Surplus
content.context: Built on the job, in production
content.problem: Surplus staff were typing hardware specs into a spreadsheet by hand, which introduced typos into the inventory. Writing product listings was also manual.
content.built: One connected pipeline: collect specs, build a master spreadsheet, and have AI write the listings, all on a private network that never touches the internet.
highlights: Handles identification, condition grading, pricing, label printing, and database export.
Runs offline: Qwen 14B across four Mac minis plus Llama 3B on one, via MLX. Replies stream word by word.
Merge rules keyed on serial number, so a low-quality read never overwrites good data.
Traced repeated cluster failures to macOS permissions and network routing.
A Listings tab builds a strict prompt from each row’s real specs, and a Cluster tab polls each node over SSH every 5 seconds.

items.name: Five-node cluster
items.text: Five M1 Mac minis on a gigabit switch with no internet uplink, fixed IPs, and passwordless SSH from the head node. Apple’s MLX framework splits one model across several machines with tensor parallelism, so a 14B model can run across Macs that can’t hold it individually.

items.name: USB spec collector
items.text: A Bash script on a USB stick runs system_profiler on each Mac, reads model, chip, RAM, storage, battery health, and macOS version, looks up year and screen size from a reference table, and de-duplicates by serial number.

items.name: Camera inventory scanner
items.text: For Macs that won’t boot, a webcam photographs the bottom label and Apple’s Vision OCR reads the model number, EMC, and serial. These are matched against the lookup table to get product, year, screen size, and resale lane (Retail, Auction, or Parts).

items.name: Merge logic
items.text: Both sources land in one master inventory keyed on serial number, so a camera scan never overwrites real data from a working machine.

items.name: Surplus AI app
items.text: A Flask server runs two model engines: Qwen 14B across four nodes, and Llama 3B on one node for quick responses. Replies stream word by word. A Listings tab builds a strict prompt from each row’s real specs, and a Cluster tab polls each node over SSH every 5 seconds.

items.name: Launchers
items.text: One double-click starts everything, waits for the engines to respond, and opens the app. Closing it shuts down every node.

nodes.label: Autonomous Supply Chain Watchtower
nodes.summary: Multi-agent LLM system: three agents in sequence on the Anthropic Claude API through CrewAI turn sales history into a logistics plan. The Risk Analyst is grounded in real shipping-disruption data over ChromaDB.

content.title: Autonomous Supply Chain Watchtower
content.problem: Turning raw sales history into a logistics plan normally takes several manual steps by different people.
content.built: Three agents running in sequence on the native Anthropic Claude API through CrewAI, each consuming the previous agent’s output. The Risk Analyst has a custom tool backed by a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline over ChromaDB, so its output is grounded in real shipping-disruption data instead of model recall. Built with Claude Code.

nodes.label: Demand Forecasting & Inventory Optimization
nodes.summary: MS capstone, team of four: demand forecasts across 250 SKU and warehouse series with a strict time-based test window. 27.7% WAPE against a 38.5% naive baseline, turned into a reorder-point policy.

content.title: Demand Forecasting & Inventory Optimization
content.oneLiner: Forecasting demand across 250 SKU and warehouse series, with a strict time-based test window.
highlights: Turned the forecast into a reorder-point policy that cuts simulated holding cost about 28% at comparable service levels.
content.credit: Team project with Rakshit Govind Thota, Sanjana Parmareddy Gari, and Yashwanth Sai Tondapu.
